{{Conjecture|legends}}
The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] established a [[Prison/Legends|penal colony]] on a large '''asteroid''' in the [[Gesaril system/Legends|Gesaril system]]. Circling the [[Gesaril system/Legends|system's]] [[Star/Legends|sun]] in a wide [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]], the prison had cells carved into the rock to hold 1,300 prisoners.
